decision: D2 - payment account and legal-entity ownership
status: accepted by owner in current conversation

recommended.provider_account_reuse: not enabled across stores in the first release
recommended.seller_of_record: the merchant legal entity accepted by Razorpay
recommended.destination: only the merchant bank destination verified and managed by Razorpay
recommended.site_switching: explicit owner action with real step-up, revision and durable operation
recommended.history: each attempt/refund/settlement retains its original connection and credential version
recommended.managed_live_activation: unavailable until actual provider approval and constitutional reconciliation

alternative: Permit account reuse only across stores with the same provider-verified legal entity after a separate ownership/consent design; never across unrelated merchants.
consequence: Determines connection uniqueness, tenant grants, account-scoped webhook dispatch and financial-history relationships. Existing sandbox setup corrections do not depend on this decision.
hosted_actions: none authorized or performed by this proposal
